title: 第9章 情难自禁的百岁少女第10章 师尊的奖励 脱了吧
slug: 被逐出宗门后师尊师姐后悔终生
content_zh:
周通单手扶起倾倒的慕容雅，支撑着她勉强盘坐。
“师尊，我要帮你镇压心魔，你能不能遮住那面镜子！”
周通指着天照镜，他不喜欢这种被别人监视的感觉。
“那还不简单，尽管我已是强弩之末，毁掉一面镜子还是能做到的。”
慕容雅目光如炬，盯着天边，有一股强悍的波动正在聚集。
“你敢！”
莫流苏急了，天照境是宗门的至宝，若被毁掉的话她将难逃重责。
但如果就此撤掉，她就没有办法继续监视周通了，这让她很不甘心。
一番计较之后，她还是做出了选择。
“你少得意，用不了多久合欢宗也会彻底消失，到时候我看谁还能庇护你这个废柴！”
话音落下，她就撤掉了天照镜，慕容雅又一口鲜血喷了出来，气息再度萎靡。
与此同时，她身上冒出了阵阵黑烟，充满了阴毒的戾气，此乃魔障，正是心魔的体现。
“小家伙快躲开，不要沾染这东西，否则你会没命的。”
慕容雅有些焦急的说道，没有人比她清楚心魔的可怕，这种力量专克精神，任何精神力孱弱的人都会被秒杀。
以她强悍的修为都被折磨的生不如死，周通一介少年，若敢轻触必将灰飞烟灭！
“您以为我是何人？区区心魔而已，我又怎会放在眼里？”
二话不说，周通直接伸手触碰慕容雅。
“不要…啊！！”
慕容雅脸色大变，刚想阻止，就感受到了两只灼热的手掌按在了自己柔软的腰间。
一瞬间，她浑身仿佛触电了，忍不住剧烈的颤抖了起来。

或许是因为心魔的缘故，她的身体变得极为敏感，那双勾人夺魄的眼眸中竟然蕴藏水雾，一副娇艳欲滴的模样。
她刚要生气，就感受到了一股无比浑厚的精神力从周通身上荡漾而生，倾刻间压制住了心魔，让她松快了许多。
“这…这是你的精神力？”
绝色的脸庞露出了前所未有的惊讶。
这纯正的精神力极为强大，正是一切心魔的克星。
然而她还不知道，这股精神力也只不过是周通的冰山一角。
前世周通距离帝境只有一步之遥，精神力甚至已经跨境了帝境，如今重生，修为虽然没有继承，但精神力却被完整的保留了。
当今世界，他称第一，几乎无人敢称第二。
“小家伙…”
慕容雅红唇微动，心底却掀起了惊涛骇浪，难道这孩子就是她命中注定的福星，合欢宗或许命不该绝呢。
一念至此，她忍不住微微一笑。
这一刹那天地失色，绝代的风华仿佛被具象化了，化成了粼粼波光，扫过凄草，扫过朽木，扫过荒原，扫过了漫漫长空。
周通惊讶的发现，周围的空间竟然有了生机勃发的迹象，这简直超出常理。
举手舞红尘，展颜牵灵圣，世间万物都为她的一颦一笑所倾倒。
合欢宗的合欢天功竟然逆天到了这种程度！
紧接着，周通微微摇头，否定了这种想法。
若真有这么厉害，合欢宗恐怕早就成了大帝宗门。
能够抬手间魅惑万物的纯在，恐怕也只有慕容雅一人而已。
强行稳住心神，周通控制手掌在慕容雅的娇躯上缓慢移动，将精神力注入各个重要穴位。
“唔…你…小家伙你轻点，我受不了！“

慕容雅突然反应极大，肩膀轻颤，玉手紧握，精致的脚趾都勾在了一起，那情不自禁的神态让周通的呼吸都沉重了许多。
“再忍一忍，马上就好了！”
一边说着，他加快了动作，精神力凝成丝线，刺激了对方体内。
“嗬…啊…呼呼呼…臭小子，不要太过分了…啊啊啊啊…”
content_en:
Zhou Tong lifted up the fallen Murong Ya with one hand and supported her to sit cross-legged.
"Master, I want to help you suppress your inner demons. Can you cover that mirror?"
Zhou Tong pointed to the Tianzhao Mirror. He didn't like the feeling of being watched by others.
"That's not easy. Even though I'm at the end of my rope, I can still destroy a mirror."
Murong Ya's eyes were as bright as a torch, staring at the horizon, where a powerful wave was gathering.
"How dare you!"
Mo Liusu was anxious. Amaterasu was the sect's most precious treasure. If it was destroyed, she would not be able to escape heavy responsibility.
But if it was withdrawn, she would have no way to continue monitoring Zhou Tong, which made her very unwilling.
After some deliberation, she made her choice.
"Don't be so proud. It won't be long before the Hehuan Sect will completely disappear. Then I'll see who can protect you, a loser!"
As soon as she finished speaking, she removed the aerial mirror. Murong Ya spat out another mouthful of blood, and her breath became weak again.
At the same time, bursts of black smoke erupted from her body, filled with sinister hostility. This was a demonic obstacle and the embodiment of inner demons.
"Little guy, get away quickly and don't get contaminated by this thing, otherwise you will die."
Murong Ya said anxiously, no one knew the horror of inner demons better than her. This kind of power only suppressed the spirit, and anyone with weak mental strength would be killed instantly.
Even with her strong cultivation, she was tortured to the point of death. If Zhou Tong, a young man, dared to touch her lightly, he would be destroyed!
"Who do you think I am? I'm just a demon, how can I take it seriously?"
Without saying anything, Zhou Tong reached out and touched Murong Ya.
"Don't...ah!!"
Murong Ya's expression changed drastically. Just when she was about to stop him, she felt two hot palms pressing on her soft waist.
For a moment, her whole body seemed to be electrocuted, and she couldn't help but tremble violently.
Perhaps because of her inner demons, her body became extremely sensitive, and there was actually mist in her seductive eyes, making her look so delicate and charming.
Just as she was about to get angry, she felt an extremely strong spiritual power rippling from Zhou Tong's body, which instantly suppressed her inner demons and made her feel much more relaxed.
"This...is this your spiritual power?"
The stunning face showed unprecedented surprise.
This pure spiritual power is extremely powerful and is the nemesis of all inner demons.
However, she didn't know yet that this spiritual power was just the tip of Zhou Tong's iceberg.
In his previous life, Zhou Tong was only one step away from the imperial realm, and his spiritual power had even crossed the imperial realm. Now that he was reborn, although his cultivation was not inherited, his spiritual power was completely retained.
In today's world, he claims to be number one, and almost no one dares to claim number two.
"Little guy..."
Murong Ya's red lips twitched slightly, but a turmoil arose in her heart. Could it be that this child was her destined lucky star, and maybe the Hehuan Sect should not die.
At this thought, she couldn't help but smile.
At this moment, the sky and the earth lost color, and the peerless elegance seemed to be embodied, turned into sparkling waves, sweeping across the grass, the rotten trees, the wasteland, and the long sky.
Zhou Tong was surprised to find that the surrounding space showed signs of vitality, which was simply beyond common sense.
Raising her hands to dance in the mortal world, showing her face to hold the Holy Spirit, everything in the world is captivated by her smile.
The Hehuan Sect's Hehuan Tian Kung is so incredible!
Then, Zhou Tong shook his head slightly and rejected this idea.
If it was really that powerful, Hehuan Sect would probably have become the Great Emperor Sect long ago.
Murong Ya is probably the only person who can enchant all things with a raised hand.
Forcibly calming his mind, Zhou Tong controlled his palms to move slowly on Murong Ya's delicate body, injecting mental power into various important acupuncture points.
"Um...you...little guy, please be gentle, I can't stand it!"
Murong Ya suddenly reacted greatly, her shoulders trembled slightly, her jade hands clenched tightly, and her delicate toes hooked together. Her uncontrollable expression made Zhou Tong's breathing become much heavier..
"Just bear with it a little longer, and you'll be fine soon!"
As he spoke, he sped up his movements, condensing his mental power into threads and stimulating the other person's body.
"Oh...ah...fufufu...bastard, don't go too far...ahhhhh..."
